card.title: IPad Air No Touch

claims.statement: iPad Air (1st gen) touch needs PP5V25_GRAPE (from PMIC 8100, underfilled) and PP1V8_GRAPE_SW (from U6500).
If supplies and connector readings are good, replace both Cumulus touch ICs (BCM5976), also found on iPhone 6/6 Plus, iPad mini 1–4 and iPad 5.

procedure: Try a new digitizer; inspect touch FPCs J6620/J6640.
Replace U6500 or PMIC if a supply is missing.
Replace both BCM5976 ICs (protect FPCs with Kapton).
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
